dogecoin.text:
The fact that @elonmusk will be hosting a SNL on 8th May, people are buying up dogecoin in anticipation hoping he'll talk about it & pump up the price. 

Will doge actually blow up?

"He/She owns 28% of all #dogecoin in supply. No, with that case dogecoin can't become the currency of the future or any democracy. Elon said that it's an unstoppable force in finance, but this fact makes the view skeptical for many experts as well." 

- @GauravBhanshali
